notes: Italy (2026-09-13). Four rates, all 'legal', SOURCED FROM THE PRIMARY TEXT via normattiva.it (the official portal of the Italian State's consolidated law): DPR 26 ottobre 1972, n. 633, art. 16 + Tabella A — 22% (ordinary, comma 1), 10% (parte III), 5% (parte II-bis), 4% (parte II, comma 2). NO ZERO ENTRY IS ADDED: the research searched the entire consolidated text of DPR 633/1972 for the literal phrase « aliquota … zero » / « aliquota del 0 » and found NONE. Two DISTINCT non-taxation regimes exist instead, not interchangeable: 'esenti' transactions (art. 10, comma 1: « Art. 10 Operazioni esenti dall'imposta Sono esenti dall'imposta: 1) le prestazioni di servizi concernenti la concessione e la negoziazione di crediti [...] » — exempt, with no deduction right, the EN 16931 'E' sense) and 'non imponibili' transactions (art. 8, comma 1, export supplies: « Art. 8 Cessioni all'esportazione. Costituiscono cessioni all'esportazione non imponibili: a) le cessioni, anche tramite commissionari, eseguite mediante trasporto o spedizione di beni fuori del territorio della Comunità economica europea [...] » — non-taxable, deduction right preserved, closer to the EN 16931 sense of the zero rate, but never qualified as a 'rate' or as '0%' by the text, which makes it a third category in its own right). This schema's EXEMPT bucket is SINGLE and cannot distinguish 'esente' from 'non imponibile' — rather than forcing one of the two regimes into a misleading EXEMPT entry, no entry is created here for either one; if a "0% / out of scope" option is ever wanted for Italy, it will be either two distinct EXEMPT entries with a very explicit `label`/`notes`, or an evolution of the schema itself. TABELLA A, PARTE I (« PRODOTTI AGRICOLI E ITTICI ») IS NOT MODELED EITHER: art. 16, comma 2 expressly excludes it (« salvo il disposto dell'articolo 34 ») — it is not a percentage a seller freely chooses but a flat-rate compensation mechanism for agricultural/fishing producers, set by a separate ministerial decree, not read by this research. 2027-01-01 REPEAL: see each entry's own note above (D.Lgs. 19 gennaio 2026, n. 10, new TUIVA, art. 34 — same figures 22/4/5/10%, only the citation changes). This catalog does not model temporality (no validFrom/validTo field in schema.ts).
